vo.text: The tab lists five profile slots for each Lynx course, with Last Updated, Stations, Update from Current and Apply Profile columns.
vo.previous_text: Profiles sit alongside Calculation and Minimum Threshold in the settings dialog, because a profile is a calculation input rather than a station edit.
vo.next_text: Each profile shows when it was last updated, by renaming it or with Update from Current, and how many stations it holds. An empty slot shows two dashes for Last Updated and Stations.

vo.text: Each profile shows when it was last updated, by renaming it or with Update from Current, and how many stations it holds. An empty slot shows two dashes for Last Updated and Stations.
vo.previous_text: The tab lists five profile slots for each Lynx course, with Last Updated, Stations, Update from Current and Apply Profile columns.
vo.next_text: Applying overwrites the Target VWC of every station the profile covers. Because that is a recalculation input, the dashboard reloads and the Suggested column changes across the course.

vo.next_text: Applying a profile is a course-wide change. Applying and pushing in the same minute leaves no time to sanity-check.
